subject: Request: POC extension and packaging options
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: POC extension and packaging options

Hey Logan —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We’re two weeks into the pilot and the team wants a little more time to validate the ingestion pipeline and run the clinician-facing latency tests. Two quick asks: 

1) Can we extend the POC by an additional 3 weeks (time-boxed)? Our security review is nearly complete but procurement needs a formal quote to approve any extension.
2) We’re re-evaluating packaging: the dev team prefers a usage-based model for the POC (credits) but procurement will only sign off on a seat-based short-term agreement or a firm quote with acceptance criteria tied to metrics.

Attached is a short note of our internal success criteria. Can Redwood provide options (time extension + credit top-up) versus a short-term seat package with a discount?

Appreciate it —
Elena

--
Elena Ramos
Director, Clinical Data Platforms
Nimbus Health
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: POC extension and packaging options

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks and the success criteria. We can do a couple of paths that should satisfy procurement and engineering: 

Option A (time + credits):
- 3-week extension on existing pilot
- 10,000 token credits top-up (usage-based) to cover additional testing
- No extra cost for the extension beyond the credits

Option B (short-term seat package):
- 6-seat, 1-month seat license (time-boxed)
- 20% introductory discount on seat fees
- Guaranteed SLA for latency on the MAP (see below)

We’re happy to tie the extension or discount to the success metrics you provided (median latency target, error rate). I’ve drafted a one-page mutual action plan (attached) and a simple ratecard for the two options.

If procurement needs a formal quote, I’ll loop in our finance lead and Marissa (copied on this email) to sign off on the discount thresholds. Which option would you prefer us to formalize?

Best,
Logan

--
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118
From: procurement@nimbushealth.com
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-11T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: POC extension and packaging options

Logan / Elena —

Procurement here. For any extension we need a formal quote that: 
- Shows total cost and payment terms
- Lists the exact deliverables and measurable acceptance criteria (we prefer the MAP approach)
- Identifies whether this is a credit top-up or a seat purchase
- Includes a point of contact and invoicing details

If you can provide a PDF quote and a DocuSign agreement, we can expedite internal approvals. Also adding Marcus Lee (our external procurement advisor) to the loop to advise on contract language.

Thanks,
procurement@nimbushealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-12T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: POC extension and packaging options

Looping in to approve a special pilot package. My take: offer Option B as the primary path (seat package) with a conditional 25% discount if Nimbus agrees to a short 6-month commitment to upgrade to Dedicated capacity within 60 days of successful POC. If they go with Option A (credits), we can do a one-time 15% credit bonus.

I’ll approve the discount on the quoted seat package up to 25% permanently for this deal, provided we capture the conversion commitment in the MAP and a signature from exec sponsor. Logan — please include conversion language in the MAP and add a clause referencing the latency acceptance criteria you discussed.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood quote and MAP for Nimbus Health (NH-2027-021)

Team —

Attached: Redwood-quote-NH-2027.pdf, Nimbus-MAP-draft.pdf, POC-ratecard.xlsx

Summary of formal offer (short version):
- Option B (primary): 6-seat, 1-month time-boxed pilot; 25% discount if Nimbus signs a 6-month Dedicated conversion within 60 days post-pilot. Acceptance criteria: median inference latency < 50ms across clinical workload, token cost <= $0.10/1k tokens during pilot.
- Option A (fallback): 3-week extension + 10k credit top-up + 15% credit bonus.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Redwood/NH-2027-021-sign

Please review and let me know which path you want formalized. If we get a signed DocuSign by Monday EOD we can schedule the extension/seat provisioning for the week of Feb 22.

Thanks —
Logan
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@procurementpartners.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood quote and MAP for Nimbus Health (NH-2027-021)

Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. Procurement is comfortable with Option B provided the following are explicitly in the signed agreement: 
- The latency and token-cost acceptance criteria as stated in the MAP (median < 50ms, <= $0.10/1k tokens).
- A 30-day review window post-pilot with the ability to cancel without penalties if acceptance criteria are missed.
- Invoicing to Nimbus Health, Attn: AP, finance@nimbushealth.com

We’ll proceed to sign the DocuSign once the three points above are added; target start for seat provisioning: Feb 22. If the MAP is finalized and signed we anticipate moving to Dedicated capacity (the conversion clause) after a successful pilot.

Appreciate the partnership —
Elena

--
Elena Ramos
Director, Clinical Data Platforms
Nimbus Health
